name: Nicole
notes: A Pyro shielder and ATK buffer. Her Skill (Revelation: Uncreated Light) makes the shield (221.2% ATK + 1,386 at level 1) and her Grace of Kenosis ATK bonus, and the Burst's Arcane Projections copy a teammate's ATK, so everything scales with ATK and the Skill carries her value; both sources put the Skill first and the Burst second. The sources agree completely: 4pc Celestial Gift (Game8: best; KQM: default for essentially all her teams), with Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City and Noblesse Oblige as alternatives; ATK% Sands (or ER), ATK% Goblet and ATK% Circlet; Angelos Heptades first with Starcaller's Watch second. Goals are Game8's: ER about 170% with double Pyro (about 150% with triple Pyro), and ATK 3,000-4,000; the lower end is set because 4,000 is only reachable with her own buffs on top. CRIT Rate 40-50% applies only with a Favonius weapon and is not set.
